description: Every quantitative artifact cited by paper_a/, with its producing script, exact command, inputs and cost class. Consumed by scripts/reproduce_paper_a.sh, which regenerates the CPU-only subset into a scratch directory and diffs it against the on-disk artifact (never overwriting it, AGENTS.md 5.5).
source_commit_note: Probe/scaffold/permutation/PA3 producers landed in c94c9bf1de; the four synthesis/stability producers in 324b0e456d; the repro driver + this manifest in 539dfcc9c0; the PA3 bootstrap-CI/Holm synthesis in b2fcaff66a. source_commit is the commit of the last PRODUCER change (b2fcaff66a); later commits touch packaging only -- the driver's interpreter substitution + package-relative out-dir (b1077c41e4) and the fold_source diff_ignore above (3898b5d8aa) -- so checking out source_commit still yields every producer this manifest names.

entries.name: metal_activity_transfer
entries.repro_notes: deterministic given the seed; XGBoost n_jobs=-1, so compare with abs_tol 1e-6. --include-raw adds the RAW (un-deduplicated) block; --comparability-note adds the Krasnov-cohort caveat (prose).
used_by: the transfer family's base report; the paper cites the derived artifacts (scaffold, permutation_null, significance, seed_stability_v2, tie_sensitivity) rather than this one directly

entries.name: metal_activity_transfer_scaffold
entries.repro_notes: scaffold grouping is deterministic (largest-first, no RNG); abs_tol 1e-6

entries.name: metal_activity_transfer_permutation_null
entries.repro_notes: 1000 shuffles, seed 42; empirical p-values are exact given the seed

entries.name: metal_activity_transfer_significance
entries.repro_notes: bootstrap 2000 resamples seed 42 (n_boot=2000 in the artifact); Holm over the 5-metal family

entries.name: metal_activity_transfer_seed_stability_v2
entries.repro_notes: 5 seeds for BOTH within and cross columns. Supersedes the v1 artifact, whose cross column captured only 3 of its 5 seeds.

entries.name: metal_activity_transfer_seed_stability
entries.repro_notes: SUPERSEDED by ..._seed_stability_v2.json. Produced by an ad-hoc workflow script (/tmp/wf_probe_attack/attack3.py, workflow wf_afc35b9d-7c4, since deleted) and its cross column covers only 3 of 5 seeds. Preserved verbatim per AGENTS.md 5.5; use v2 for the paper.
used_by: superseded; retained as a historical record

entries.name: metal_activity_transfer_tie_sensitivity
entries.repro_notes: runs the probe's within-metal regime under --tie-rule active and inactive over seeds 42/43/44/49/123, for the metals that have ties (Ru, Ir)

entries.name: pa3_chemprop_lomo_probe_cohort
entries.repro_notes: The synthesis (report + XGB-probe comparison + label-permutation null + Holm-Bonferroni + a 2,000-resample bootstrap CI on the PA3 seed-42 cross ranking) is CPU and deterministic, reproducing the canonical exactly (~20 s). The INPUT report is GPU-produced by molmetal/scripts/train_chemprop_lomo_paper_cohort.py (--config configs/pa3_chemprop_lomo_v1.yaml, cuda:0 bf16, ~5 min); bf16 is not bit-reproducible (~0.01-0.03 per-seed AUC drift, metal means stable to <=0.02). Re-training the report then re-running this synthesis is the full chain; only the report half is GPU. Parity gap: the report stores per-fold AUCs for the within-metal column but no per-ligand OOF scores, so within_metal_bootstrap_ci / transfer_penalty_ci cannot be recomputed without a GPU re-run that dumps them; only the cross column carries a CI.

entries.name: tmqm_pretrain_init_ab_ru
entries.repro_notes: The synthesis is CPU and deterministic; the two raw arm JSONs it reads are GPU-produced by molmetal/scripts/finetune_metalcytotox_from_tmqm.py (--include-gpu to regenerate those). Reproduces the on-disk value/value_std/arms/paired_delta/gate exactly.

entries.name: tmqm_bond_perception
entries.repro_notes: CPU synthesis over three bench reports (produced by molmetal/scripts/bench_tmqm_bond_perception.py, CPU). The numeric tables reproduce to <=1 ULP; prose blocks are carried as constants.

entries.name: metalcytotox_ru_paper_lightgbm_cv
entries.repro_notes: Requires the DOI-split fold files. They default to /tmp/wf_m1_paper_cv/folds; ship them in the submission package and pass --folds-dir. --regenerate-folds rebuilds a leak-free partition that does NOT match the stored folds, so use the shipped files. The artifact's fold_source field is a verbatim echo of --folds-dir, so it is environment-specific and excluded from the diff (diff_ignore); the fold content is validated transitively by the 10 per-fold roc_auc/pr_auc values.

entries.name: metalcytotox_ru_auc
entries.repro_notes: The metric mixes a Wf-124 P3 run (Ru seed 0, 30 epochs, RTX 5090, ~463 s) with a paper_protocol_measurement block whose raw evidence was /tmp/wf_m1_paper_cv/summary.json (ephemeral). The exact command/config for the paper_protocol_measurement sub-block is not pinned in the artifact and must be recovered before this entry can be marked reproducible.

entries.name: moleculenet_auc_dmpnn_5seed
entries.repro_notes: 5 seeds x 4 tasks; the per-task configs and launcher are not yet pinned in the artifact. TODO: pin before submission.

entries.name: nci60_precious_9cell_auc
entries.repro_notes: GPU ~7.2 h (45 runs = 9 cells x 5 seeds x 50 epochs). Skipped by default in reproduce_paper_a.sh; opt in with --include-gpu-long.

entries.name: metal_lomo_auc_wasserstein
entries.repro_notes: The producer is committed, but the artifact does not pin the exact command/config (it records n_runs_completed/n_runs_target, i.e. a partially completed sweep). Not reproducible until the run's config is pinned. Cited in paper_a/sections/06_limitations.tex for the cohort-trap numbers.
